apps.name: Soccer Stats
apps.subtitle: Track goals, assists, and match stats
apps.localizedDescription: Track your player’s goals, assists, and match stats across seasons, and score games live from the sideline.

versions.localizedDescription:
- Today's games stay in Upcoming until you tap "Finish scoring" on the game
  (or the day ends), so you can close and reopen scoring as often as you
  like. Once scoring starts, the card shows "In progress" and the score
- Saving a game's details (like ticking Guest player) no longer moves
  today's game to Results

- Mark a game as "Didn't play (missed this game)" when your player wasn't
  there. The result still counts toward the team's record and standings, but
  it's left out of your player's games, goals, assists, milestones and
  charts. The game gets a Missed tag
- (2.8.0 never reached the iPhone app because GitHub's build Macs were
  backed up; this is the same update)

- Tap an upcoming game's location to open it in Google Maps (the Google
  Maps app if you have it, otherwise Google Maps in Safari)

- Live score in the Dynamic Island and on the lock screen: while you score a
  game in the iPhone app, the score and your player's goals and assists show
  up there and update with every tap
  - Long-press the Dynamic Island for both team names and the full score
  - Tap it (or the lock screen card) to jump back to the scoring screen
  - After Done, the final score stays on the lock screen for 30 minutes
  - If it doesn't appear, check Settings → Soccer Stats → Live Activities

- Games dated after today always show under Upcoming, even if one was
  marked played by mistake. They stay out of the team's record and your
  player's stats until the day comes, with nothing to fix by hand
